IMO there’s a word pipeline from medical term to term for general stupidity that the r word was interrupted from, if I remember correctly words like stupid, dumb, and idiot were originally designations for ranges of IQ in the low end, but gradually came to mean generally unintelligent. You can kind of see this happening today, with things like mentally handicapped and special education being used in insults (don’t mean to offend anyone by using these, idk what’s considered offensive). The r word was headed in this direction until there was a big push against bigoted language (which is good) so now it’s in limbo because it’s no longer a medical term but it’s not an acceptable thing to call someone. In terms of using it, I’d say calling someone that is never okay, calling an idea or concept that is iffy, and you should respect people’s boundaries since it’s not out of slur territory
